model_interpretation.claim: Regrouper le parcours par quatre tuiles de lignes consécutives pour chaque tuile de colonnes peut améliorer la réutilisation de la même région de B dans le cache. model_interpretation.claim: With the selected 8x128 CTA output footprint held fixed at 1024 outputs, assigning each of 128 threads a 2-row by 4-column-stripe microtile may reuse A across four outputs and B across two rows while keeping column accesses contiguous. The eight independent FP32 accumulators and reduced thread count may cost registers or latency hiding; compare against both the selected 1x4 parent and the equal-output-count one-output control.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cu"],"retained":["Change the per-thread tile from one row by four column stripes to two rows by four stripes, producing eight independent FP32 accumulators.","Keep the CTA output footprint at 8x128 (1024 outputs), using a 32x4 block so the experiment is not a larger-output-tile comparison.","Reuse each A value across four column stripes and each B value across two rows while maintaining contiguous lane traversal across columns.","Guard row and column tails, use size_t matrix offsets, and apply alpha and beta exactly once to each valid output."]}
